notes: Brother Horn (bible 5.8, 4.2, 4.3, 4.5), the Warden of the Knot. Not placed yet: Horn's Hall and the Fold belong to the Knot (E27 and later), so he stands in the debug conversation room. Voice: slow, short, plain sentences with pauses; he never roars words. One dialogue, entries tried in order: the endings (Vespers Rung lines, and the abbot-joined silence), the Act III shaft barks (horn.at-shaft), rescue remarks (horn.rescue-pending, by horn.rescues 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5+), the Fold confrontation after a trick and its 'angry, then weary' re-entry after the player fled (horn.fold-fled), the Trial of Horns won, the yield after a fight (spare or finish him), help-done, befriended, spared, tricked-return and the first meetings by class (knight, archer, sorcerer, thief, any), then return. Resolutions set horn.fate: kill-fx (dead), spare-fx, honest-fx (trick), befriend-fx, trial-fx2 and help-fx (alive). Befriend triggers each have their own scene behind befriend-gate: horn.hymn-hummed, horn.ring-held, horn.name-stone-held, snig.vouched, clatter.vouched, horn.weapon-lowered; the sorcerer can also read the axe runes (his name). The knight's Trial of Horns starts a duel the quest runs (horn.trial-offered, event horn.trial.begin) and sets horn.trial-won. The main quest (mw-e39.4) sets the facts named in horn-dialogue.json. The reveal is shown, not told: in the Fold the narrator describes the sleepers before Horn says a word.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Stop.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You are awake. That is... unusual. Most who come this far are not.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Stop.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You stand like the barony's men stood. They were brave, and they were always leaving.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Stop. Your hand is on the string.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You looked at me a long time before you drew. Look longer.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Stop.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You read my walls the way the monks read their books. Slowly. With your lips moving. I watched you do it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Stop.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Small steps. Careful hands. I do not mind a thief. I mind who sends one.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Who sent you? The town? The abbot's new hands? I do not know which you are.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Tell me, or turn around. I would rather you did not stay between the two.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You came back.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Have you thought on it? Or have you only come to try the door again?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You hum the Vesper hymn, low, the way the monks did at dusk. It is not very good. It is the right tune.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: ...Vespers.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The monks sang that at the close of every day. I have not heard it from a living mouth in sixty-one years.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You hum it badly. I do not mind. Hold the last note. Yes. There.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You hold out the horn-ring. His hand closes around it as though it were hot.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: My mother's. Bronze, and a little bent. She wore it on the left horn. I was small. I used to chew it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: A man prised it off a carving of her. You took it back. Through the dark. Through my halls.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You could have sold it. Hornfolk bronze is heavy. I will remember this. Slowly. I remember everything slowly.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You show him the name-stone, river-smooth, cut with one long, low word. It hums faintly in the air near his breath.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Oorr. Thruum.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: That is her name. My mother's. I thought it gone from the world. The one who could say it is... me. Only me.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Keep it a moment. Let me hear it. ... There. Now I have heard it twice.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Snig told me you would come.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: He talks very quickly. I caught a third. 'Pockets. Brave. Smells like soup.' I think it was praise.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The goblins do not vouch for many. Never a human, to me. They are honest about what they dislike.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Very well. I will hear you.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Anselm sent you.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The gardener. He tends his pale mushrooms in the Ossuary. He does not know me. I know him.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Sixty-one years I have walked past him. Sometimes he apologises as he swings. He cannot even hit properly.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: He would not speak for someone who meant harm. He has never learned how.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He circles you once. Twice. A third time, slowly, as large as a doorway. Then he stops.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You waited. Sword down. You let me look.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Everyone runs, or swings. No one has stood still in sixty-one years.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I have looked. Speak, if you will. I will listen.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Come. I will not tell it. It is shorter to see.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The way is open. Walk slowly. They are sleeping. Waking is the dangerous part.

options.text: What is down there? The missing...
I came for the bounty on the beast of the old mine.
I am not here to fight.
I ask the Trial of Horns.
Those runes on your axe. May I read them aloud?
The ferns on the stair were trampled. Someone carries them down. Gently.
I could slip past you. We both know it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The monks called me Brother Horn. It was a kindness. I have kept it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I keep this place. That is all I am. Go back up.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Nothing that is yours.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Go back up the stair. Please. It is the easy way.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Beast.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: So that is the word, now. I understand it. It is not a lie. It is only not all of it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I will not let you pass. I would rather not hurt you. Do not make me choose.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Everyone says that. With a hand on the hilt.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Put it down, then. And wait. I am slow. I am patient. I will watch what you do.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You see well. Yes. I carry them.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Gently. I would rather you did not follow. But you have already seen the ferns.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Perhaps. You walk quietly. So did the abbot.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: If you go past me, I will find you where you stop. I would rather you asked.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Go carefully. The dark is not kind to the careless.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The Trial of Horns.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: ...You know the form. Who taught you? No. Do not say. It does not matter.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: No killing. First to three clean parries or blocks earns the right to be heard.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Few remember. I had thought none did. Take your stance. I will strike true, and not hard.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The runes are a name, long, in low doubled sounds. You read them aloud. Slowly. You get it right.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: ...That is my name.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: My true one. The monks never learned to say it. The last one who read that well took the bell's tongue.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: But he never read it to me. Go on. Say it again. I am listening.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He makes a low sound like a landslide that has decided to be kind. It takes you a moment to understand that he is laughing.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Three. Clean. The barony's men knew the form, once. They stopped keeping it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I am glad. I am very glad. You have the right now. Ask, and I will answer.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Enough.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I am done. Hear me, or finish it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Because you came for them.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I will tell it all, if you will listen. I cannot say it standing.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You listened. Thank you.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: There is a song under the mountain. It calls the sleeping. I catch them on the stair and lay them in the Fold, where the song is faint.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Not to harm. Never to harm. The door is behind me. You will see, when I can stand.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I am hurt, and I am old. I cannot hold the shaft when the song rises. Not as I am.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Juniper's salve would help. Or a healer's craft. Or rest among the sleepers. Any of them.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Then it is done.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: They are not dead. The ones below. They sleep. Let them sleep.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Ring the bell. ...Waking is... the dangerous part.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Moss beds in rows. Six sleepers, and a girl, the youngest, breathing slowly, in time. Bread beside every one. Chalk tallies on the wall.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Behind you, the floor shifts under a heavy tread.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You walk quietly. So did the abbot. Why are you here?

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You are in the Fold.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You ran.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: And you came back. To the Fold. To them.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Away from them.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Away. Now.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: ...No. Sit.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You have seen. It is done. I am not angry. I am tired. I have been tired for a long time.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Go, then. I will not stop you.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I will be here. I am always here.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: They walk in their sleep. The song calls them. Most nights I find one on the stair.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I carry them here. Moss. Bread. A bandage. They do not wake. Waking is the dangerous part.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The goblins bring the bread. They cannot hear the song. They do not dream. It is why I trust them.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I should have asked for help. Sixty-one years. I never asked. Now you know. What you do with it is yours.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Stay as long as you like. Sit with them. I talk to them. They do not mind.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You are still here. Good. They like company.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Sit. I am still sore. I am glad you stayed your hand.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Ask. I will answer what I can. I am not quick today.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Ask, if you want. Or sit. Both are allowed.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Good. You came back.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Ask, or sit. Both are allowed.

options.text: You carried three novices out, sixty-one years ago.
Is there a way up to the priory that is not the shaft?
I brought bread for the sleepers.
Rest, among them. I will stay close.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Six from the glen. Moss, the tanner. Ettie. Rowan, Harlan, Mina. Fitch from the Ox. I know their breathing apart.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: And a girl. The baker's. She walked to the gate on your first night. I carried her down. She hums, even asleep.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: It is a dream that hungers. It sleeps under the Cradle. The Hornfolk could not kill it, so they wrote a prison around it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The monks rang a bell each dusk, and it slept deeper. Then the abbot took the tongue. It has not slept well since.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: We were slow to speak. We are slow to die, too. I am the last. The others walked the Knot until they stopped.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Our statues cover their ears. It is not shame. It is the work. You must not listen, to keep it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: My name. Hornfolk names are long. A mouth that cannot finish it should not start.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You may call me Horn. The monks did. It was a kindness.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Three. Small. They did not stop shaking for a day.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Ysolde was one. She asked if the bell would ring again. I said yes. I was lying. I have been hoping since.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Corvin. A kind man. He laughed with his whole face.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: He is not that now. He is a song that remembers being a man.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: He will say I am in his way. He is right.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Old. Slowly. Like a stair going soft. I had thought to ask the goblins to keep the watch.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: They would do it badly. They would do it. That is the thing.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The passage was mine to fall. I brought the roof down behind me, sixty-one years ago. With the novices.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I can open it from this side. It is not easy. Go, then. I will hold the way.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The Knot is a sentence. The man cut it in the middle. The song leaks through the gap.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Close the gap, and it is whole. Collapse it. Freeze it, and shore it. Or have the goblins wall it. They build well.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Come. Slowly.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: ...Bread. For them.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: They will be hungry, when they wake. I could not bring enough. I thank you.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: ...It stings. Good.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Sixty-one years, and no one has thought to ask. Thank you.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Yes. I will lie with them. I will hum.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Do not go far. If the song rises, wake me. Waking is... it is only dangerous for them.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Go carefully.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The breach is sealed. I can feel it. The sentence is whole.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The sleepers have bread. I am mended. I did not think to say this to anyone.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Thank you. For the bread. For the stone. For staying.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Go up. Ring it, when you can. I will keep the watch. I am not afraid of it now.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You were on the stair. Not breathing well. I carried you down.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: It is no trouble. Rest. The bandage is clean.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Again.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Twice now. I do not mind. But the dark is not kind to the careless. Be less brave, or more careful. They are not the same.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Three.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I keep a tally on the wall, in chalk. Your mark is three strokes. I would like it to stop at three.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Four.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I am not angry. I am old, and you are heavy. Heavy, and stubborn.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Again.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I ran out of wall to count on. I have stopped. Go slowly. I am not as strong as I was when you began.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I cannot hold it. Not like this.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Heal me, or let me rest with them. Then I will stand.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Go up. I have the foot. Nothing climbs past me.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: They are loud tonight. Let them be loud. Climb.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Ring it. I will be here. I am always here.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The bell rang. I heard it from the foot of the shaft. Wrong, and beautiful.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The song slept. And I slept, a little. A moment. No one came to harm.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The breach is closed. The Knot is a sentence again, a whole one. The song will not come to the town. You did that.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Anselm walked past me this morning. Humming a real tune. He told me his name. I had it already. I let him tell it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The baker's girl asked who I was. I said Brother Horn. She said that was a funny thing to call a bull. I said it was a kindness. She did not understand. That is a kindness too.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Kettleback's people will keep the watch when I cannot. Badly. With a great deal of noise. It will do.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: The town brings bread to the gate now. Hale told me. I do not know what to do with it. I will learn.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I will stay below. Someone must. Rest, when you can. I will. Soon. Not yet.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: You did not ring it.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: I can hear all of it now. The whole valley breathing in time. I am awake. I am the only one.

nodes.speaker: horn
nodes.text: Go on. Go to him. I will not stop you. I tried, once.
